items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who's George and Brian? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I missed the point because I knew I wasn't going to be able to do this.

ctx.x: Do you know? You recognize it? Yeah. Who's George and Brian? Yeah. It just sounded sort of vaguely for me, you know, without knowing quite what it was.
I missed the point because I knew I wasn't going to be able to do this.
